description: The Portal: prepare (unsigned) using a Portal disk you hold on one of YOUR crews: x3 points for 48 hours, and the disk is burned. One Portal at a time per crew and a disk must be used within 7 days of purchase. Refused with the reason if you do not hold it, it is used or expired, or the crew is not yours or already has a Portal running. Costs only gas.

contractSet.description: Optional: "v2" (live Games Master v2 contracts) or "legacy" (retired original Season 1 contracts). Only needed if you hold the same id in both; otherwise v2 is tried first, then legacy.

portalId.description: The Portal disk token id (my_shop_items lists yours).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_use_portal
